description: Fire-induced collapse test on an existing building with a truss roof by Tongji University is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Jinyu Li, tongji university. The dataset is about a fire-induced collapse on an actual building with a truss roof.The dataset contains the test truss's thermal and structural responses, the fuel's mass loss, the heat release rates, and the videos of the entire test. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Fire-incduced collapse test; Truss roof; Performance-based fire design. Published 2024-01-10. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
